title: Vendor DS4 Q8_0 correctness scaffold before performance benchmark

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

candidate.name: default-off MXFP4 x Q8_0 correctness scaffold
candidate.purpose: prove that CUDA can consume the exact CPU fallback Q8_0 activation rows before connecting direct top768 hot pool to compute
candidate.expected_token_rate_change: none; probe does not write model outputs
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: no strict France benchmark in this step; probe is env-gated and should only add tiny temporary diagnostic buffers when enabled
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: none when unset; diagnostic-only run may be slower but cannot be promoted

implementation_boundary: Do not change accepted default runtime behavior.
Do not repeat or promote the old dirty scalar Q8_0 up-only output path.
Wire CPU fallback Q8_0 activation row base and row size into a separate CUDA probe interface.
The probe may compute a small bounded number of rows/cols and compare against CPU fallback output already present in dst.
The probe must write a CSV/summary only when GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_PROBE_OUT is set.
The probe must not modify dst or skip CPU fallback.
correctness_gate: First gate is op-level Q8_0 probe max_abs/mean_abs against CPU fallback for selected MXFP4 rows.
If op-level error is suspicious, reject before any token-level run.
Any future output-writing Q8_0 path must pass llama-results fixed-text top1 with same_top1 == n_tokens before any performance benchmark.
rollback_rule: If build fails, revert runtime source and keep this artifact only if it documents the failure.
If the probe changes default accepted path, revert.
If a future output-writing path fails top1 or France semantic correctness, revert runtime source.
promotion_rule: This scaffold cannot be promoted as SOTA.

A later performance result can be promoted only if eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, RAM including page cache <= 16000000000 bytes with MemorySwapMax=0, France output is coherent and semantically correct, full reproduction metadata is recorded, source/artifacts are committed and pushed, and pushed-source reproduction passes.
